sources.quote: The redirect_uri must be a complete HTTPS URL (including the https:// prefix)
sources.verified: Region-specific consent hosts; scope advertising::campaign_management; HTTPS allow-listed redirects only. Single-use code expires after five minutes; access tokens last 60 minutes. sources.quote: The response from GET /v2/profiles includes a maximum of 5000 items.
sources.verified: Regional GET /v2/profiles has no Scope header and exposes currency, timezone, marketplace and seller/vendor/agency identity. Default profiles have view/edit campaign permission. Scoped campaign calls require the profile header even for single-profile advertisers; POST SP list uses spCampaign.v3 media. OM profile cap remains 100.

sources.quote: Reporting API v3 will be deprecated on June 30, 2027.
sources.verified: Reporting v3 deprecation date is 2027-06-30. Async request/status/download with GZIP_JSON; PENDING/PROCESSING/COMPLETED lifecycle. DAILY requires date. Identical requests return 425; generation can take three hours. Amazon-Ads-AccountId is required across ad products. R1 only parses PENDING/COMPLETED; account-ID acquisition/binding is unresolved and blocks admission.

spCampaigns date-range cap 31 days, retention 95 days; SB campaign retention 60 days, SD 65 days. Cost samples are plain numbers, not micros; currency/timezone meaning remains unverified. No SB campaign-spend preset added.

sources.quote: Contained within that response is a Retry-After header.

Rechecked 2026-10-24: date format alone does not establish profile timezone or inclusive/exclusive campaign calendar boundaries. Budget-rule inclusivity is a separate schema and is not campaign evidence. Neutral translation returns unavailable with no I/O.
